🌟 ProxyBridge | C
🎯 Primary Use Case: To transparently route application network traffic through HTTP or SOCKS5 proxies on Windows, macOS, and Linux, offering an alternative to existing proxifier tools.
✨ Key Features: • Transparent proxy routing for TCP and UDP traffic • Supports SOCKS5 and HTTP proxies • Per-application traffic control (route, block, allow) • System-level operation, compatible with proxy-unaware applications
📖 Summary: ProxyBridge is a universal proxy client for Windows, macOS, and Linux that acts as a Proxifier alternative. It enables transparent routing of TCP and UDP traffic from applications through SOCKS5 or HTTP proxies, allowing granular control over traffic flow on a per-application basis.
